findings.title: A failed fresh run leaves an older passing cache entry active
findings.specimen: attavo/testtool.py: the code adds cache entries on exit 0 but never removes an existing entry when the same key is rerun with --fresh and fails
findings.retires: The assumption that caching only the newly returned exit code guarantees every failure is followed by a real rerun
findings.severity: Blocking when a cached passing tree is rerun with --fresh, that run fails, and the unchanged tree is tested again without --fresh; the third invocation incorrectly returns the old cached pass

findings.title: Whole-suite mode cannot apply per-test executor exclusions
findings.specimen: attavo/testtool.py: all mode reduces the selection to ["tests"], while exclusion only removes exact identifiers present in that list
findings.retires: The mapped-mode exclusion test as evidence that --all has the promised same exclusion behavior
findings.severity: Blocking when ATTAVO_STAGE is set, --all is used, and exclude_in_executor contains specific test identifiers; those tests still run inside the executor

findings.title: Early-returning test invocations leave no event
findings.specimen: attavo/testtool.py: missing item/manifest configuration, incompatible --all plus names, selector failure, and change-discovery failure return before _event
findings.retires: The three successful mode invocations as evidence for the specification's one test event per invocation guarantee
findings.severity: Blocking when ATTAVO_EVENTS is set and attavo test exits through any validation, discovery, or selector error path; the feed contains no record of the invocation
